questions.question:
다음 글의 빈칸 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어디에도 들어갈 수 없는 단어는?

I'm Tim. Hope is my ___ⓐ___ dog and my best friend. She is by my ___ⓑ___ 24/7. She ___ⓒ___ goes to school with me. Is she a good student? Well, she ___ⓓ___ just sleeps in class, but the teachers don't ___ⓔ___. On weekends, we go to the park and play together. With Hope, I feel free and strong. Together, we are happy.
questions.explanation: 'mind'는 '신경 쓰다'의 의미로 부정문에서 사용되어야 하므로(teachers don't mind), ⓔ 자리에만 들어갈 수 있다. 따라서 어디에도 들어갈 수 없는 단어는 'mind'이다.

questions.question:
다음 대화의 빈칸 (A), (B)에 공통으로 들어갈 말로 적절한 것은?

Ann: Hello. I'm Ann Smith. ________(A)________.
Dongmin: _______(B)_______. I'm Lee Dongmin.
Ann: You play the guitar so well, Dongmin.
Dongmin: Thanks. I love playing it.
questions.explanation: 처음 만나는 상황이므로 (A)와 (B)에 모두 '처음 뵙겠습니다(Nice to meet you)'가 적절하다.

options: With Minsu, Jihun laughs a lot.
They are members of the same band.
questions.question:
다음 글의 Jihun과 Minsu에 대한 내용으로 일치하지 않는 것은?

I'm Jihun. My best friend is Minsu. Minsu and I love rock music. We are members of the school band Rock It. I play the guitar, and Minsu plays the drums. We are not good players, but we have so much fun together. With Minsu, I laugh all the time. Together, we are happy.
questions.explanation: 글에서 'We are not good players'라고 명시되어 있으므로, Minsu가 드럼을 잘 치는 훌륭한 드러머가 아니다.

options: Did you pass the history test?
questions.question:
다음 대화의 빈칸 (A)에 들어갈 말로 가장 알맞은 것은?

Betty: What are you doing, Laura?
Laura: I'm solving math problems. I like studying math, but I don't like history.
____________(A)____________?
Betty: I love studying English. But math is too difficult for me.
questions.explanation: Laura가 자신의 과목 선호도를 말했으므로, Betty가 'How about you?'로 자신의 선호도를 묻는 것이 자연스럽다.

questions.question:
[지문]
I'm Tim. Hope is my guide dog and my best friend. She is by my side 24/7. She even goes to school with me. Is she a good student? Well, she mostly sleeps in class, but the teachers don't mind. On weekends, we go to the park and play together.

아래 대화의 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

Jimmy: How are you doing, Tim?
Tim: Very Good! What about you?
Jimmy: Not bad. Your dog is so cute.
Tim: ⓐ She is my guide dog, and her name is Hope.
Jimmy: Do you bring Hope to school with you?
Tim: ⓑ That's right. ⓒ Hope is always with me.
Jimmy: That's so sweet. Class is starting soon. Where does Hope stay during class?
Tim: ⓓ She waits outside the classroom.
Jimmy: She is such a good girl.
Jimmy: What do you do on weekends?
Tim: ⓔ Every weekend, I go to the park with Hope.
Jimmy: Can I join you this weekend?
Tim: That sounds great!
questions.explanation: 글에서 언급되지 않은 것은 ⓓ 'She waits outside the classroom'이다. 글에서는 Hope가 수업 중에 어디에 있는지 명확히 말하지 않는다.

questions.question:
다음 주어진 문장을 부정문으로 가장 바르게 바꾼 것은?

Jane likes studying English.
questions.explanation: 3인칭 단수 현재형 'likes'의 부정문은 'does not(doesn't) like'를 사용하며, 동사는 원형으로 돌아가야 한다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 흐름상 어색한 것은?

I'm Hannah. Mrs. Schmidt, my neighbor, is a ⓐ dear friend to me. She is a great listener, and I often talk with her. She ⓑ talks much. She just nods and smiles at me. Sometimes I'm ⓒ sad, and she bakes a cake for me. Her cake is yummy, and I feel all right, ⓓ like magic. With Mrs. Schmidt, I feel at home. Together, we are ⓔ happy.
questions.explanation: ⓑ 'talks much'는 앞의 'great listener'와 모순된다. 'doesn't talk much'로 수정되어야 한다.

options: Tim이 Taylor Swift를 좋아하는 이유는 무엇인가?
Tim은 Taylor Swift의 노래를 얼마나 자주 듣는가?
Linda는 Taylor Swift의 노래를 들어본 적이 있는가?
Tim은 Taylor Swift의 노래를 언제부터 듣기 시작했는가?
questions.question:
다음 대화를 읽고 답할 수 없는 것은?

Linda: Who is your favorite singer?
Tim: My favorite singer is Taylor Swift.
Linda: I know just a few of her songs. When did you start listening to her music?
Tim: I started listening to her songs about five years ago.
Linda: Oh did you? Why do you like her so much?
Tim: Her voice is amazing!
Linda: How often do you listen to her songs?
Tim: Almost every day! Her songs just make my day better.
questions.explanation: 대화에서 Linda가 Taylor Swift의 노래를 좋아하는지에 대해 언급하지 않았으므로, 이에 대해 답할 수 없다.

questions.question:
주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?

I'm Tim. Hope is my guide dog and my best friend.

(A) She is by my side 24/7. She even goes to school with me.
(B) On weekends, we go to the park and play together.
(C) Is she a good student? Well, she mostly sleeps in class, but the teachers don't mind.
questions.explanation: 자연스러운 흐름은: Hope와의 관계(A) → 학교에서의 모습(C) → 주말 활동(B) 순서이다.

questions.question:
자연스러운 흐름의 대화가 되도록 (A)~(D)를 적절하게 배열한 것은?

(A) Thanks. I love playing it.
(B) Nice to meet you, too, Ann. I'm Lee Dongmin.
(C) You play the guitar so well, Dongmin.
(D) Hello. I'm Ann Smith. Nice to meet you.
questions.explanation: 자연스러운 대화 순서: 인사(D) → 상호 인사(B) → 칭찬(C) → 감사(A)

options: Hannah는 종종 Mrs. Schmidt와 대화를 나눈다.
Mrs. Schmidt는 말을 많이 하기보다 주로 듣는 편이다.
Hannah는 Mrs. Schmidt와 함께 있을 때 편안함을 느낀다.
Mrs. Schmidt는 Hannah가 슬플 때 대화를 통해 위로해 준다.
questions.question:
Hannah에 관한 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

I'm Hannah. Mrs. Schmidt, my neighbor, is a dear friend to me. She is a great listener, and I often talk with her. She doesn't talk much. She just nods and smiles at me. Sometimes I'm sad, and she bakes a cake for me. Her cake is yummy, and I feel all right, like magic.

With Mrs. Schmidt, I feel at home. Together, we are happy.
questions.explanation: 글에서 Mrs. Schmidt는 Hannah가 슬플 때 케이크를 구워주며 위로한다고 했으므로, 대화를 통해 위로한다는 표현은 부정확하다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 괄호 (A), (B), (C)에서 어법에 맞는 말이 바르게 짝 지어진 것은?

My best friend is Minsu. Minsu and I (A) [love / loves] rock music. We are members of the school band Rock It. I play the guitar, and Minsu (B) [play / plays] the drums. We are not good players, but we (C) [has / have] so much fun together.
questions.explanation: (A) 'Minsu and I'는 복수이므로 'love' (B) 'Minsu'는 3인칭 단수이므로 'plays' (C) 'we'는 복수이므로 'have'

questions.question:
다음 글에 드러난 Tim이 Hope와 함께 있을 때 느끼는 심경으로 가장 적절한 것은?

I'm Tim. Hope is my guide dog and my best friend. She is by my side 24/7. She even goes to school with me. Is she a good student? Well, she mostly sleeps in class, but the teachers don't mind. On weekends, we go to the park and play together. With Hope, I feel free and strong. Together, we are happy.
questions.explanation: 글에서 'With Hope, I feel free and strong. Together, we are happy'라고 명시되어 있으므로, Tim은 Hope와 함께 있을 때 자유롭고 강하며 행복함을 느낀다. 이는 감사하고 지지받는 느낌(thankful and supported)에 가장 부합한다.

questions.question:
밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 틀린 be동사는?

I ⓐam Jihun. My best friend ⓑis Minsu. Minsu and I love rock music. He and I ⓒam members of the school band Rock It. I play the guitar, and Minsu plays the drums. We ⓓare not good players, but we have so much fun together. With Minsu, I laugh all the time. With me, Minsu ⓔis happy.
questions.explanation: ⓒ에서 주어가 'He and I'(복수)인데 'am'(단수)을 사용했으므로 틀렸다. 'are members'가 되어야 한다. 다른 문장들은 모두 주어와 be동사가 일치한다.

questions.question:
밑줄 친 ㉠의 단어와 바꿔 쓸 수 있는 말은?

With Minsu, I laugh ㉠all the time.
questions.explanation: 'all the time'은 '항상, 언제나'라는 뜻이므로 'always'와 같은 의미이다.

options: Dongmin이는 약 5년 전에 기타를 치기 시작했다.
Ann은 Dongmin이가 기타를 잘 친다고 생각한다.
questions.question:
다음 대화의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

Ann: Hello. I'm Ann. Nice to meet you.
Dongmin: Nice to meet you, too, Ann. I'm Dongmin.
Ann: You play the guitar so well, Dongmin.
Dongmin: Thanks. I love playing it.
Ann: When did you start to play it?
Dongmin: About 5 years ago.
Ann: Wow, that's amazing. Do you play in a band?
Dongmin: Yes, I play in the school band.
Ann: That's nice. Actually, I'm learning the guitar.
Dongmin: Oh, are you?
Ann: I just started last week, so I'm not very good at it yet.
questions.explanation: 대화에서 두 사람이 처음 만나는 것으로 보인다('Nice to meet you'). 따라서 '두 사람은 가까운 친구 사이이다'는 내용과 일치하지 않는다.

options: Hope chases birds all day in the park
Hope gives me confidence and independence
Hope behaves well even when she sleeps
I feel strong because the teachers don't mind
I clean up the park after playing with Hope
questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

I'm Tim. Hope is my guide dog and my best friend. She is by my side 24/7. She even goes to school with me. Is she a good student? Well, she mostly sleeps in class, but the teachers don't mind. On weekends, we go to the park and play together. ______________________________. Together, we are happy.
questions.explanation: 뒤에 'With Hope, I feel free and strong'이라는 내용이 이어지므로, 빈칸에는 Hope가 Tim에게 주는 긍정적인 영향을 설명하는 'Hope gives me confidence and independence'가 가장 적절하다.

options: Do they go to school together?
Does your sister goes to bed early?
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 바르지 않은 문장은?
questions.explanation: 'Does your sister goes to bed early?'는 조동사 'does' 뒤에 동사원형이 와야 하므로 'goes'가 아닌 'go'를 사용해야 한다. 정정: 'Does your sister go to bed early?'

options: musical : a group of musicians who play music together
guide : to cook food, like bread, in an oven with dry heat
nod : to move the head down and then up again quickly
pop : to make a sound with your voice because you think something is funny
questions.question: 단어에 대한 영영풀이가 옳은 것은?
questions.explanation: 'nod'의 정의는 'to move the head down and then up again quickly'가 맞다. 다른 보기는: hearing(들을 수 있는 능력), musical(음악 그룹이 아닌 형용사), guide(요리하는 것이 아님), pop(웃음으로 내는 소리가 아님)이므로 틀렸다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 빈칸 (A)에 들어갈 말로 가장 알맞은 것은?

I'm Jihun. My best friend is Minsu. Minsu and I love rock music. We are members of the school band Rock It. I play the guitar, and Minsu plays the drums. We are not good players, ___(A)___ we have so much fun together. With Minsu, I laugh all the time. Together, we are happy.
questions.explanation: 'We are not good players'와 'we have so much fun together'는 대조적인 내용이므로 'but'이 적절하다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 Schmidt 부인에 대한 설명으로 일치하는 것끼리 짝지어진 것은?

I'm Hannah. Mrs. Schmidt, my neighbor, is a dear friend to me. She is a great listener, and I often talk with her. She doesn't talk much. She just nods and smiles at me. Sometimes I'm sad, and she bakes a cake for me. Her cake is yummy, and I feel all right, like magic. With Mrs. Schmidt, I feel at home. Together, we are happy.

ⓐ She has many friends.
ⓑ She sometimes bakes cakes.
ⓒ Cake is her favorite dessert.
ⓓ She is taking a cooking class.
ⓔ She often gives advice to Hannah.
ⓕ With her, Hannah feels comfortable.
questions.explanation: 글에서 'Sometimes I'm sad, and she bakes a cake for me'(ⓑ 일치), 'With Mrs. Schmidt, I feel at home'(ⓕ일치)이므로 ⓑ와 ⓕ가 맞다.

options: 우리는 과학 과제를 끝내지 못했다. → We didn't finished the science project.
나는 어제 엄마를 위한 케이크를 만들었다. → I maked a cake for my mom yesterday.
내 남동생은 지난달에 새 자전거를 샀다. → My brother bought a new bike last month.
나는 지난 주말에 아빠와 공원에서 농구를 했다. → Last weekend, I play basketball with my dad in the park.
내 친구는 3주 전에 영화 '해리포터'를 다시 봤다. → My friend watches the movie Harry Potter again three weeks ago.
questions.question: 한글 문장을 영어로 올바르게 옮긴 것을 고르시오.
questions.explanation: 'My brother bought a new bike last month'는 문법적으로 올바르다. 다른 보기는: ①'didn't finished' (finished 제거), ②'maked' (made로 수정), ④'play' (played로 수정), ⑤'watches' (watched로 수정) 필요.

options: She is not go to school with me.
She do not go to school with me.
She do not goes to school with me.
She doesn't goes to school with me.
She does not go to school with me.
questions.question:
[지문]
I'm Tim.
Hope is my guide dog and my best friend. (A)
She is by my side 24/7. (B)
ⓐ She goes to school with me. (C)
Well, she mostly sleeps in class, but the teachers don't mind. (D)
On weekends, we go to the park and play together. (E)
With Hope, I feel free and strong.
Together, we are happy.

윗글의 문장 ⓐ를 부정문으로 바꿀 때 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: 'She goes to school with me'는 현재시제 3인칭 단수이므로 부정문은 'She does not go to school with me'가 맞다. 조동사 'does' 뒤에는 동사원형 'go'가 와야 한다.

options: Tim goes to school with Hope.
Hope and Tim go to the park together.
questions.question:
[지문]
I'm Tim.
Hope is my guide dog and my best friend. (A)
She is by my side 24/7. (B)
ⓐ She goes to school with me. (C)
Well, she mostly sleeps in class, but the teachers don't mind. (D)
On weekends, we go to the park and play together. (E)
With Hope, I feel free and strong.
Together, we are happy.

윗글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?
questions.explanation: 글에서 'she mostly sleeps in class'라고 했으므로 Hope가 수업 중 주로 자지, Tim이 자는 것은 아니다. 따라서 'Tim mostly sleeps in class'는 내용과 일치하지 않는다.

questions.question:
[지문]
I'm Tim.
Hope is my guide dog and my best friend. (A)
She is by my side 24/7. (B)
ⓐ She goes to school with me. (C)
Well, she mostly sleeps in class, but the teachers don't mind. (D)
On weekends, we go to the park and play together. (E)
With Hope, I feel free and strong.
Together, we are happy.

윗글의 (A)~(E) 중 다음 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은?

Is she a good student?
questions.explanation: 'Is she a good student?'는 'She goes to school with me' 이후에 나와야 Hope가 학생인지에 대한 질문이 자연스럽다. 그 다음 'Well, she mostly sleeps in class'로 이어지므로 (B) 다음이 적절하다. 위치 상 (B)와 (C) 사이, 즉 지문의 첫 번째 (A) 위치에 들어가야 한다.
